overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for ultra-endgame scenarios and optimizing colonist psychology state machines for zero-latency transitions. This batch closes the remaining gaps in long-term simulation stability and AI response fidelity.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Compression for Ultra-Endgame Ticks
acceptance_criteria: StateCompressor handles up to 1024 states without heap allocation.
GetFinalHash produces identical results across all platforms for identical input sequences.
Zero dynamic memory allocations during compression cycle.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times for long-running simulations; consistent save/load behavior.

tasks.title: Optimize Colonist Psychology State Machine for Zero-Latency Transitions
acceptance_criteria: State transitions complete in O(1) average time for common states.
No heap allocations during state machine initialization or transition.
All 16,500 logged footsteps map correctly to psychological states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother animation transitions; more responsive colonist behavior in dense scenes.
